semantics.identity_rule: Each determinism profile has an explicit identity/version.
semantics.random_rule: Random seed/source semantics are explicit where applicable.
semantics.clock_rule: Clock/time inputs are controlled or explicitly declared variable.
semantics.external_rule: External dependency behavior/version is fixed, mocked or declared non-deterministic.
semantics.result_rule: Allowed deterministic equivalence criteria are explicit.
semantics.authority_rule: Deterministic behavior does not imply correctness/authorization.

invariants.rule: Test definitions, fixtures, results, coverage, simulations and release evidence never become production semantic authority or grant production execution rights merely by existing or passing.
Verification evidence binds exact test/profile/source/runtime revisions and declared environment inputs so a pass/fail result cannot silently float across unrelated versions or targets.
